claims.text: Glucocorticoid courses: incl PJP ppx, gastroprotection and bone protection per local guidelines.
claims.quote: should incorporate prophylaxis against Pneumocystis pneumonia along with gastroprotection and bone protection, according to local guidelines

claims.text: TMP-SMX during high-dose prednisone to prevent Pneumocystis; may also apply to rituximab.
claims.quote: prophylactic trimethoprim- sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX) should be administered during periods of high-dose prednisone therapy to prevent Pneumocystis infection. This strategy may also apply to other immunosuppressive agents such as rituximab

claims.text: Bisphosphonates (⍉in kidney failure) to ↓bone loss on prolonged glucocorticoids.
claims.quote: Bisphosphonates (except in the presence of kidney failure) are used to minimize loss of bone density during prolonged treatment with glucocorticoids

claims.text: ACR GIOP: medium, high or very high fracture risk → pharmacologic tx.
claims.quote: For adults at medium, high, or very high fracture risk, we strongly recommend pharmacologic treatment
